notes: Ducati's workhorse ECU of the 999/749/air-cooled-Monster era: 749 and 999 Superbikes, 998, the injected air-cooled Monsters (620 through 1000), Multistrada 1000/1100, SportClassic GT1000 / Paul Smart / Sport 1000, S2R, S4R and ST4S. The GuzziDiag and TuneECU ecosystems both speak to it. This entry is a placeholder built from those tools' compatibility lists: no identifier, session or memory sequence has been captured from a 59M here, so it is identification-only until one is. Identification, fault codes and the read-only discovery sweep are safe; everything else waits for a capture. If you own one of these bikes, a single recorded session upgrades the whole family. Established from the published GuzziDiag/IAWDiag changelogs (see docs/PRIOR_ART.md §8), not from a capture: CO-Trim is supported. The tip-over sensor state uses the same encoding as 5AM.

kline.note: 10400 baud is the Marelli standard of this era; fast vs slow init and the ECU address follow the sibling Marelli ECUs and are unconfirmed on a 59M.
